finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Accept both |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat as off |

The other 8 warnings are real deprecations. `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/adapter.js` is the one to fix next. It is dropped in v5.
